name: LIŪMI Contour Lifting Serum
headline: Contour Lifting Serum
description: A microneedle lifting serum that visibly firms and redefines the contour of the face. Use where skin feels lax — jawline, cheeks, around the eyes.
howToUse: In the evening, roll the microneedle applicator over the target area, then press in the serum.

manufacturing.expiration: 3 years from the date of manufacture; 12 months after opening
manufacturing.storage: Store at room temperature, away from direct sunlight.
manufacturing.ingredients: Aqua, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, 1,2-Hexanediol, Dipropylene Glycol, Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate, Bakuchiol, Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Tromethamine, Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate, Undaria Pinnatifida Extract and other INCI components.
